title: Sign and notarize Developer ID releases
objective: Replace ad-hoc release artifacts with universal Developer ID-signed and notarized Beadle archives that pass Gatekeeper and can be distributed through the existing Homebrew cask, while keeping local development builds ad-hoc and keeping all credentials out of the repository.
acceptance_criteria: Local builds remain ad-hoc signed by default, while release builds require an explicit Developer ID Application identity and use hardened runtime plus a secure timestamp.
The release workflow imports a password-protected signing certificate into an ephemeral keychain without committing credentials.
The release workflow submits the signed ZIP to Apple's notary service, staples and validates the ticket on Beadle.app, then recreates the final ZIP and checksum.
The universal executable, bundle metadata, Developer ID signature and Gatekeeper assessment are verified before GitHub release publication.
Release documentation lists the required GitHub secrets and the order-sensitive signing, notarization, stapling and checksum flow.
maquina contract validate, maquina policy check, swift build and git diff --check pass.
